# tebib_volume (Resource)

An empty block storage volume (Ceph RBD). Attach it to a VM with `tebib_volume_attachment`. It can grow in place; a smaller size replaces it. Deleting it destroys its data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_volume" "data" {
  name     = "data"
  size_gib = 50
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's volumes. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `size_gib` (Number) Size in GiB (1-2048). Growing it resizes in place (then grow the filesystem in the guest).

### Optional

- `delete_on_termination` (Boolean) Delete the volume when the VM it is attached to is deleted. Default: `false`.
- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `boot` (Boolean) Whether it is a VM's boot volume.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Volume ID (`vol-...`).
- `source_image` (String) Image a boot volume was made from.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibHost resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.
- `vm_id` (String) The VM it is attached to, if any (managed by `tebib_volume_attachment`).

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tebib_volume.data vol-abc123
```
